sloka: इयम् सा लक्ष्यते लन्का पुरी रावण पालिता ।सासुर उरग गन्धर्वैर् अमरैर् अपि दुर्जया ॥६-३७-४॥।।
transliteration: iyam sā lakṣyate lankā purī rāvaṇa pālitā ।sāsura uraga gandharvair amarair api durjayā ॥6-37-4॥।।

translations.english: "This Lanka city ruled by Ravana is seen. It appears that this city is unconquerable to Devas, demons and Gandharvas also by the immortals."
translations.hindi: वे कहने लगे-देखो, रावण-शालित लङ्का नगरी, देव्यां नागों और गन्धर्वो से भी अजेय है
